title: Barbacans
html_source:
1. an outwork of a fortified place, as a castle.

  2. a defensive outpost of any sort.

Appears in ‘Telemachus’ and ‘Circe’ though not in Stephen’s mind despite ‘shafts of light’ being present in all three mentions of the barbacans.
